title: 'The hardest report I've ever done': Photographing young girls sold by their parents in Afghanistan
subhead: The Visa pour l'Image festival in Perpignan, southern France, is exhibiting journalist Elise Blanchard's photographs from her latest report in the country ruled by the Taliban, where she lived from 2018 to 2025.

Former gang member found guilty of murdering rap icon Tupac Shakur
subhead: A jury found Duane "Keffe D" Davis guilty of orchestrating the 1996 killing of the hip-hop artist, finally bringing a measure of resolution to a case that had gripped fans and lingered in the public imagination for decades.

title: Five years after deadly migrant shipwreck in the English Channel, rescuers blame each other: 'It's too easy to say we didn't know'
subhead: During a confrontation before an investigating judge in June, the duty officer and the operator at the maritime rescue center presented irreconcilable accounts of the events of November 24, 2021. That night, 31 people drowned between French and British waters.

title: 'It is just as wrong to make social media the sole cause of adolescent distress as it is to deny its power to amplify it'
subhead: Our responsibility as adults is neither to abandon teenagers in digital spaces nor to keep them away from them, as young people’s mental health deserves better than a clash between technophiles and technophobes, writes child psychiatrist Pierre Fourneret in an op-ed for Le Monde.

title: 'With a promise, the future becomes the present': Hope takes shape in Barcelona's public squares
subhead: 'Room for Hope' (5/6). A major influence on many spaces for thought and public discussion in the Catalan capital, philosopher Marina Garces sees even modest actions that 'interrupt the irreversible' as the 'faces of hope.'

'Even our ancestors do not remember a flood of this scale:' Nepal villagers face apocalypse frozen in mud
subhead: Warned in time, many residents of Devighat managed to evacuate their homes just minutes before the mudslide killed over 900 people in Nepal and China. They have started to return to the village, where rescuers are still looking for survivors and the deceased in extremely perilous conditions.

title: How hard-left politician Rima Hassan is testing the boundaries between free speech and provocation
subhead: Hassan will stand trial for 'terrorism glorification' in October, over a tweet citing one of the perpetrators of the 1972 Tel Aviv airport attack. Le Monde looks back at two and a half years of controversies and legal proceedings involving one of France's most prominent pro-Palestinian voices.

title: Isabelle Huppert: 'The way I enter the stage is fundamental'
subhead: In an interview with Le Monde, the acclaimed French actress discusses her approach to acting and the importance of the 'first gesture' in theater. She also reflects on some of the most significant memories from her film career, shaped by many long-standing collaborations.
